jobs.title: Creative Director - Design
jobs.description:
Creative Director, Advertising Design / Art Direction
thelab
| Digital Advertising Agency | New York, NY (Hybrid)

About thelab
thelab is an agency of makers with deep expertise in solving creative, production, and technology challenges. Our focus is on making better work to help brands work better, and our production roots ensure that every great idea gets delivered right. From brand campaigns and shoot production to social, experiential, and retail, thelab mixes inspiration and hard work to produce results that mean business.

The Role
We're looking for a Creative Director with exquisite design sensibility and the strategic thinking to back it up. This is a net-new leadership role dedicated to one of thelab's most prestigious accounts, a luxury brand operating across a fully integrated marketing ecosystem where the creative bar is high and the opportunity is significant.
You'll report to the ECD team and work alongside a cross-capability group that includes paid social strategists, organic social strategists, brand strategists, and a Director of Project Management. You'll be in the room with the client regularly, so presence, a clear point of view, and the ability to articulate creative decisions with confidence are essential.

What You'll Do

Creative Leadership

Own the full creative direction vision across all channels and touchpoints, including art direction, design, and copy, ensuring a cohesive and elevated brand aesthetic
Concept, develop, and oversee creative across TV/CTV, paid social, organic social, experiential, retail, and trade environments
Work with and provide clear, confident direction to copywriters as a true creative partner
Maintain a high standard of craft at every stage, from early concepting through final execution
Lead and mentor a small but growing team of designers and copywriters (3-5 direct reports), fostering a culture of ambition, collaboration, and creative rigor

Strategy & Integration

Think at the account level, with a clear understanding of business objectives, audience dynamics, and how creative drives results across the full marketing ecosystem
Collaborate closely with paid and organic social strategists, brand strategy, and the ECD team to ensure creative is integrated and purposeful across every channel
Bring a point of view to briefs, not just an execution, and push thinking upstream when the work calls for it

Client Partnership

Serve as a primary creative voice in client presentations and ongoing creative reviews, building trust and credibility with the client team
Articulate creative decisions clearly and confidently, and navigate feedback with both openness and conviction
Help grow the relationship through the quality of the work and the strength of the partnership

Production

Lead and oversee shoot production for campaign and content work, with a strong eye for casting, set design, photography, and film direction
Partner with production and project management to deliver ambitious creative on time and on budget

What You Bring
10-12 years of design and art direction experience, with significant time at an agency working on integrated brand campaigns
A portfolio that demonstrates exquisite design taste, elevated, considered, and channel-fluent
Deep experience across TV/CTV, paid social, organic social, experiential, and retail
Proven experience with luxury brands and a clear understanding of the visual language, restraint, and standard of craft that luxury demands
Strong shoot production experience; comfortable on set and skilled at getting the most out of a production
A history of thinking strategically at the account level, not just executional excellence
Experience managing, inspiring, and developing a team of creatives
Exceptional client-facing skills; confident, compelling, and collaborative in the room
Comfort working within a cross-capability team and a clear understanding of how design functions within a fully integrated program

Nice to Have
Experience with luxury appliance, home goods, or premium lifestyle categories
Familiarity with trade marketing as an audience (designers, architects, specifiers)

thelab is an equal opportunity employer. We celebrate diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all employees.

Hybrid - in Madison Square office Tues-Thurs
Benefits include health/vision/dental with Anthem BCBS, 401k match, unlimited PTO and pretty great snacks
Salary of $165,000-$175,000 commensurate with experience

jobs.title: Creative Director, Brand
jobs.description:
About The Role

Chime is looking for a Creative Director to shape what our brand looks, sounds and feels like — and to turn that into work people actually talk about.

This is an in-house creative leadership role on our Brand & Creative Marketing team. You will set the creative vision for integrated campaigns and carry it through every expression of the brand: brand films and broadcast, social-first work, partnerships and activations, and the always-on content that keeps a brand present between campaigns. You will lead a small in-house team of art directors, designers and copywriters, and direct the external agencies, production companies and partners who help scale the work.

We are looking for someone who thinks in platforms rather than executions — who can find the idea that holds up across a :30, a partnership, a feed and a retail moment. You should be comfortable pitching bold top-of-funnel brand work while understanding how the rest of the funnel earns it: campaigns that build awareness, move consideration and support conversion, and that stay honestly connected to what the business needs.

The base salary offered for this role and level of experience will begin at $201,000.00 and up to $279,000.00. Full-time employees are also eligible for a bonus, competitive equity package, and benefits. The actual base salary offered may be higher, depending on your location, skills, qualifications, and experience.

In this role, you can expect to

Set and evolve the creative vision for the Chime brand, and translate it into storytelling that drives awareness and consideration
Lead integrated campaigns end to end — from platform and concept through production and final execution — across brand film and broadcast, social, partnerships, activations and owned channels
Champion bold ideas, and make the case for them clearly to marketing, product and executive stakeholders
Build creative that travels: social-first thinking, talent and partner collaborations, and moments designed to be shared rather than served
Partner with brand, growth, product marketing and media leads so that campaign ideas hold up across the full funnel and are measurable against business goals
Lead, mentor and grow a team of art directors, designers and copywriters, and set the standard for the quality of work the team ships
Run creative reviews and brainstorms that raise the level of the idea, with clear direction and feedback people can act on
Manage external creative agencies, production houses, and media and talent partners, and hold them to the same bar
Use the tools that make a modern creative team faster — including AI in concepting, iteration and production — and help the team adopt what genuinely works
Keep a sharp read on our members, the category and the cultural landscape, and let it shape the work

To thrive in this role, you have

8+ years in creative leadership, including at least 5 leading brand-level work
A portfolio of consumer-facing campaigns you can walk us through — the strategic problem, the idea, and what happened
At least one brand platform you built or meaningfully shaped that changed how people saw a company
Experience in a creative agency environment, and the craft standard that comes with it
Work that has run in more than one form: brand film or broadcast produced with agency and production partners, social-native work, and partnership or activation initiatives
A track record leading and developing a small in-house creative team, and getting the best out of external partners
Fluency across the funnel, including the view that lower-funnel work is a creative problem too
Excellent communication and presentation skills — you can sell an idea into a skeptical room and explain why it is right
Practical experience using AI tools in the creative process, and a point of view on where they help and where they do not

A Little About Us

At Chime, we believe that everyone can achieve financial progress. We created Chime—a financial technology company, not a bank*—on the premise that core banking services should be helpful, easy, and free. Through our user-friendly tools and intuitive platforms, we empower our members to take control of their finances and work towards their goals. Whether it's starting a savings account, purchasing a first car or home, launching a business, or pursuing higher education, we're proud to have helped millions unlock their financial potential.

We're a team of problem solvers, dreamers, and builders with one shared obsession: our members. From day one, Chimers have worked tirelessly to out-hustle and out-execute competitors to bring our mission to life. Their grit and determination inspire us to work harder every day to deliver the very best experience possible. We each bring an owner's mindset to our work, refusing to be outdone and holding ourselves accountable to meet and exceed the highest bars for our teams, our company, and our members.

We believe in being bold, dreaming big, and taking risks, while also working together, embracing our diverse perspectives, and giving each other honest feedback. Our culture remains deeply entrepreneurial, encouraging every Chimer to see themselves as stewards of our mission to help everyday Americans unlock their financial progress.

We know that to achieve our mission, we must earn and keep people's trust—so we hold ourselves to the highest standards of integrity in everything we do. These aren't just words on a wall—our values are embedded in every aspect of our business, serving as a north star that guides us as we work to help millions achieve their financial potential.

Because if we don't—who will?

Chime is a financial technology company, not a bank. Banking services provided by The Bancorp Bank, N.A. or Stride Bank, N.A., Members FDIC.

What We Offer For Our Full-time, Regular Employees

🏢 Our in-office work policy is designed to keep you connected - with four days a week in the office and Fridays from home for those near one of our offices, plus team and company-wide events depending on location. Whether you’re coming in regularly or are part of our fully remote program, you’ll stay engaged with your work and teammates.
💻 Benefits that support your work and life, including backup child, elder, and pet care and subsidized commuter benefits for eligible employees.
✨ Comprehensive health, financial, and wellbeing benefits designed to support you at every stage of life.
🏝 Generous vacation policy and company-wide paid days off
🫂 1% of your time off to support local community organizations of your choice
👟 Annual wellness stipend to use towards eligible wellness related expenses
👶 Up to 22 weeks of paid parental leave for birthing parents and 12 weeks of paid parental leave for non-birthing parents
👪 Access to family planning reimbursement
💚 A challenging and fulfilling opportunity to join one of the most experienced teams in FinTech and help millions unlock financial progress

We know that great work can’t be done without a diverse team and inclusive environment. That’s why we specifically look for individuals of varying strengths, skills, backgrounds, and ideas to join our team. We believe this gives us a competitive advantage to better serve our members and helps us all grow as Chimers and individuals.

Chime is proud to be an Equal Opportunity Employer. We consider qualified applicants without regard to race, color, ancestry, religion, sex, national origin, sexual orientation, gender identity, age, marital or family status, disability, genetic information, veteran status, or any other legally protected basis under provincial, federal, state, and local laws, regulations, or ordinances. We will also consider qualified applicants with criminal histories in a manner consistent with the requirements of state and local laws, including the San Francisco Fair Chance Ordinance, Cook County Ordinance, NYC Fair Chance Act, and the LA City Fair Chance Ordinance, and consistent with Canadian provincial and federal laws. If you have a disability or special need that requires accommodation during any stage of the application process, please contact: accommodations@chime.com.

To learn more about how Chime collects and uses your personal information during the application process, please see the Chime Applicant Privacy Notice.

jobs.title: Associate Art Director
jobs.description:
Veronica Beard is looking for an Associate Art Director to work closely alongside the creative team in creating and executing graphic requests for multi-departmental needs. This role is based in our New York office and reports directly to the Digital Art Director.

Responsibilities
:

Support the Digital Art Director in leading the development of multi-platform, multi-channel campaigns, creating visually compelling static and video designs that align with business objectives and the brand marketing strategy.
Maintain and enhance brand standards, ensuring brand consistency across all channels while introducing fresh, innovative ideas
Collaborate with the Digital Art Director to guide creative team in producing high-quality print and digital assets for seasonal launches, promotional campaigns, e-commerce assets, and sales.
Contribute to the creative process for site refreshes, email design, digital storytelling, and special projects such as seasonal direct mail pieces, in-store signage, and invitations.
Assist in overseeing social media content creation, including image cropping, grid layouts, video editing, and designing IG Reels, TikToks, and IGS that reflect the brand’s tone and visual identity.
Provide support for pre-production of brand campaigns, including gathering visual references, contributing to casting decisions, and assisting in overall creative development.
Assist in post-production, working closely with the Digital Art Director to coordinate retouching, manage deliverables, and ensure timelines are met.
Ownership of photo shoots for our wholesale selling platform, JOOR, including overseeing pre-production, providing creative direction during the shoot, and ensuring assets meet brand guidelines and the needs of the wholesale team.
Collaborate with cross-functional teams in ensuring smooth asset delivery across marketing, e-commerce, and social media channels.

Requirements:

5-7 years of design and art direction experience in a related field (fashion / luxury a plus)
BA / BFA in a design, or similar
Eye for design, clean + sophisticated aesthetic, and strong interest in fashion
Strong voice, highly motivated, self-managed, and able to think independently
Excellent typography skills with elevated level of taste and ability to apply modern design aesthetics across projects of varied styles
Innovative thinker always seeking to grow and push brand direction forward
Proficient in Adobe Creative Suite (Photoshop, InDesign, Illustrator, After Effects, Premiere Pro, Capture One, and XD)
Well-rounded creative portfolio with design, branding, and art direction projects
Previous experience at luxury lifestyle, fashion or creative agency is preferred
Responds positively to feedback and adapts quickly to change
Thinks with both sides of the brain: creative vision and strong organizational skills
Takes initiative and understands no task is too small
Excellent interpersonal, time & project management, and communication skills
Ability to work calmly under pressure, and meet tight deadlines with a strong sense of accountability
Strong organizational and interpersonal skills
E-Commerce art direction skills are a plus

The base salary range for this role is between $90,000 and $100,000. The relevant base salary will vary depending on wide range of factors that are considered in making compensation decisions, including but not limited to, skill sets, experience, training, degrees, and certifications. The base salary is just one component of our total compensation offerings, which consist of a comprehensive benefits package as well as a short-term incentive program, clothing allowance, and merchandise discounts

At Veronica Beard, we are committed to creating and maintaining a workplace where every single employee can thrive and feel valued. As a company, we firmly believe that there is strength in diversity. We seek to recruit talent from a variety of perspectives and backgrounds and are actively seeking candidates with a dedication to advancing equity, inclusion, and racial and social justice in their work.

Veronica Beard is committed to an environment of mutual respect and is an EEO/Affirmative Action Employer. No employee or applicant is discriminated against because of race, color, sex (including pregnancy), age, national origin, religion, sexual orientation, gender identity, gender expression, parental status, status as a veteran, and basis of disability or any other federal, state or local protected class.
